consequence.statement: Setups that match on specific cert-manager log strings could break, because the unstructured log messages have been replaced with structured logs.
consequence.remediation: Review and update any log matching, alerting or parsing rules that depend on specific cert-manager log message strings.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, log messages that were not structured are now structured logs, so any setup that matches on specific log strings could break.
